subject: Launching aircraft beside flying ones: kept flights, fixed lanes and layers per aircraft, 4 m separation minimum

trigger.observed: Launching Drone2 while Drone1 returned, and Drone3 while Drone2 searched, was impossible: four plan_task attempts in two minutes, two 'participants' rejections (the route template dropped the flying drone that was named) and two 'separation' rejections (Drone3's egress crossed Drone2's return lane 8 cm away at the same 38 m layer because lanes were numbered per plan). Wonder waited for each drone to land.

changes.kept_flights: service.kept_flights passes airborne drones outside the tasking to Fleet.apply_plan; the receipt merges their branches and missions, nothing is sent to them, inspections carry to the new version and only new branches start searching
changes.lanes: allocation.branches assigns rows and layers by LANE_ORDER position, independent of the plan's participants
changes.separation: geodesy.MIN_SEPARATION_M 0.10 -> 4.0 (pads 5 m apart); test fixtures that encoded 0.1 m updated; rear-pad returns now wait for their front column
changes.routes: route tasks take one aircraft per route; an unnamed fleet defaults to that, a named surplus is the participants rejection
changes.prompt: name only the aircraft to task; flying aircraft left out keep their plans; describe_location is not for narration

checks.web_tests: 208 pass; one vite dev-server path test fails only when run from a nested worktree

region_evaluation_after_change.note: identical containment and direction results to measurements/tasking-planner-grid.json; the 4 m minimum and fixed layers rejected no recorded briefing; slowest plan 28.9 s
